hints.title: Feasibility is monotone
hints.body: If some rate finishes all piles in time, every larger rate also finishes in time. The answer is the first rate that is fast enough.

hints.title: Measure one candidate rate
hints.body: A pile of size `p` needs `ceil(p / rate)` hours, because the worker never moves to another pile during the same hour.

hints.title: Binary search the answer
hints.body: The answer lies between `1` and the largest pile. Use the total-hours calculation as the monotone predicate.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
low = 1
high = max(piles)
while low < high:
    mid = (low + high) / 2
    total = 0
    for p in piles:
        total = total + ceil(p / mid)
    if total <= hours: high = mid
    else: low = mid + 1
return low
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
